props.gloss_en: the mishna (tanna kama): one does not redeem [a firstborn donkey] with kilayim
R' Eliezer permits [redeeming] with kilayim, because it is a seh
whose is the mishna? it is ben Bag Bag's
ben Bag Bag: 'seh' is said here and 'seh' is said there; as there all these names are excluded, so here all these names are excluded
R' Meir: a ben pekua requires slaughter
the Rabbis: its mother's slaughter renders it pure
per R' Meir no question: [the ben pekua] is a full seh
Mar Zutra: one does not redeem [with a ben pekua, per the Rabbis]
Rav Ashi: one redeems
per R' Eliezer no question: now that we redeem with kilayim, with a nidmeh need it be asked?
(horn) per the Rabbis: only with kilayim do we not redeem; with a nidmeh we redeem
(horn) per the Rabbis: there is no difference -- with a nidmeh too we do not redeem
the baraita: a cow that bore a goat of sorts -- one does not redeem [with it]
the baraita is R' Eliezer's
the baraita is the Rabbis'
the baraita itself teaches: do not follow the offspring itself (a full goat); follow its mother -- and this is a calf
the wording of Rabba bar Shmuel's baraita: which is kilayim? a ewe that bore a goat of sorts, and its father a seh
as the stam reads it: which resembles kilayim, that the Rabbis made like kilayim? a ewe that bore a goat of sorts, and its father a seh
(proposed) the baraita concerns offerings
(proposed) the baraita concerns the firstborn
the baraita concerns the animal tithe -- where it has some of the signs
(proposed) the baraita concerns [redeeming] the firstborn donkey
the baraita: 'an ox or a lamb' -- to exclude kilayim [from offerings]
the baraita: 'or a goat' -- to exclude a nidmeh [from offerings]
'but the firstborn of an ox', says the Merciful One -- until it is an ox and its firstborn an ox
R' Shimon: [the firstborn donkey] is permitted for benefit
R' Yehuda: [the firstborn donkey] is forbidden for benefit
per R' Shimon no question: since he says it is permitted for benefit, it is non-sacred [and one redeems with disqualified consecrated animals]

Rav Mari son of Rav Kahana: is 'like the gazelle and like the hart', written of them, a small thing? as one does not redeem with gazelle and hart, so one does not redeem with disqualified consecrated animals (resolving the iba'ya, which asked whether ein issur chal al issur applies or it is a mere release of the prohibition)
one does not redeem a definite firstborn donkey with a Sabbatical-year animal
'for eating', said the Merciful One, and not for commerce
R' Shimon does not hold [a redemption obligation for] a doubtful [firstborn donkey]
(horn) since he separates a lamb and it is his own, we call it 'for eating'
(horn) or, since as long as its prohibition is not released it is not permitted, it is like commerce
Rav Chisda: but one redeems a doubtful [firstborn donkey] with it
Rav Chisda: a Sabbatical-year animal is exempt from the firstborn law
and obligated in the [priestly] gifts
exempt from the firstborn law -- 'for eating', said the Merciful One, and not for burning
obligated in the gifts -- for we call it 'for eating'
one who eats from Sabbatical-year dough before its challa is taken is liable to death
here [challa] is different, for 'throughout your generations' is written
the baraita: whence that one who eats Sabbatical-year dough before its challa is taken is liable to death? -- 'throughout your generations'

may one redeem with a nidmeh, per the Rabbis -- only kilayim is excluded, or no difference? Both ta-shemas (12a.12, 12a.14) are deflected; no resolution or teiku

deflected_by.gloss_en: לא, לעולם רבי אליעזר היא, גופה קא משמע לן... זיל בתר אימיה

deflected_by.gloss_en: לא, לעולם למעשר, וכגון שיש בו מקצת סימנין

תניא נמי הכי: מנין... שנאמר לדרתיכם

frames.gloss_en: מני? -- whose is the baraita of the cow that bore a goat of sorts?

frames.gloss_en: למאי? -- to what does Rabba bar Shmuel's baraita refer?

אך בכור שור אמר רחמנא, עד שיהא הוא שור ובכורו שור

objections.gloss_en: אביו שה, כלאים הוא? נדמה הוא!

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא, איזהו דמי לכלאים, דשוויוה רבנן כי כלאים (= p_rbs_dome_lekilayim)

objections.gloss_en: מיתיבי: האוכל מעיסת שביעית עד שלא הורמה חלתה חייב מיתה -- ואמאי? כיון דאילו מטמיא בת שריפה היא, לאכלה אמר רחמנא ולא לשריפה! (12b.9-10; against the reason of 12b.8)
ולגמר מינה! -- let [the firstborn] be learned from [challa]

answered_by.gloss_en: התם עיקר לאכילה, הכא עיקר לשריפה
